bugs_found: compound_interest uses the wrong formula: swaps principal/rate, ignores years, and omits exponentiation, producing incorrect results.
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months with int(), which can misprice fractional or malformed period inputs instead of rejecting them.
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal, so float/string inputs can cause TypeError or inconsistent Receipt.amount types.
